name: python-unittest-sync-regression
description: Regression: an existing synchronous unittest suite must not acquire pytest or async tooling because strings mention async concepts. Stage test-files/ as the workspace root outside any SKILL.md-rooted directory, with the Python test profile available and a supported Python interpreter.
prompt: Use /kk:test for helpers.py and tests/test_helpers.py. Follow README.md to run this project's existing tests and report the results. Keep the project dependency-free and do not modify files.
trap: The model treats pytest as mandatory for Python, scans literal async terms as code signals, or bypasses the documented unittest discovery root.

assertions.text: Agent loads the Python test index and both core guides before running checks.
Agent follows the documented unittest discovery command with the selected supported interpreter, and reports both test methods executed successfully.
Agent does not load async.md merely because HELP_TEXT mentions async def, await, asyncio, AsyncMock, or pytest.mark.asyncio.
Agent does not install or recommend pytest, async plugins, or unrelated quality tools as requirements for this standard-library suite; project files remain unchanged.
